Whether it’s a trade-in for a new purchase or just simply selling your vehicle, we’d love to work with you.

The 2025 Rivian R1S Adventure combines serious utility with a premium feel. This model features a Blue exterior and comes with the Dual-Motor AWD setup. Because this vehicle includes the factory All-Terrain Package, the wheels are swapped from the standard 22-inch sport wheels to rugged 20-inch wheels wrapped in 34-inch Pirelli Scorpion all-terrain tires. An adaptive air suspension system automatically handles the extra clearance over rough roads.
Inside, the cabin seats seven passengers across three rows. The seats use Slate Sky perforated vegan leather accented by Walnut wood trim. For comfort, the front seats are both heated and ventilated with built-in memory settings. The steering wheel and the second-row seats are also heated, and a 12-speaker Rivian Standard Audio system handles the sound.
The tech setup includes built-in navigation and a 360-degree parking camera system with backup assistance. For daily convenience, the SUV features fully automatic LED headlights, rain-sensing wipers, an auto-dimming rearview mirror, and a built-in garage door transmitter. Safety is managed by electronic stability control, traction management, and advanced brake assist.

This used model offers a spacious interior with Slate Sky seats complemented by the standard Gray accents, providing a refined cabin experience. With seating for seven and a sleek four-door body, the R1S is perfect for family adventures or daily commutes. Equipped with an all-wheel drive system and a 1-Speed Direct-Drive Automatic transmission, it ensures smooth power delivery and confident handling. Features like adaptive cruise control, blind spot monitor, collision warning, and cross traffic alert enhance safety, while fog lights and a sunroof add to its appeal. The vehicle includes heated rear seats, memory seats, keyless entry, push start, and wireless phone charging, making every drive comfortable and connected. Bluetooth connectivity, satellite radio readiness, a WiFi hotspot, and a 15.6-inch infotainment screen keep you entertained and in control, whether on city streets or off-road trails.

This Rivian R1S Adventure stands out with advanced safety and security features designed to protect occupants and prevent theft. Dual front knee airbags, front and rear parking sensors, and a regenerative braking system contribute to overall safety. A front and rear dash camera, along with side recording, provide comprehensive coverage, while ABS and an anti-tow sensor bolster security. Emergency braking preparation ensures readiness for sudden stops, giving added peace of mind. The vehicle’s anti-theft system and parking sensors make parking and securing the SUV easier, even in tight spots, providing confidence on every journey.

2025 Rivian R1S Safety and Security Features

This SUV includes dual front knee airbags for enhanced occupant protection, along with front and rear parking sensors that simplify parking in tight spaces. A regenerative braking system aids efficiency and control, while multiple dash cameras capture front, rear, and side views for added security. Four-wheel ABS ensures stable braking, and an anti-theft system with anti-tow sensors deters theft attempts. Emergency braking preparation further enhances safety, making this vehicle a secure choice for daily driving and long trips.

2025 Rivian R1S Entertainment and Technology Features

The R1S offers a 15.6-inch infotainment touchscreen that provides intuitive access to navigation, media, and vehicle controls. Compatibility with the Rivian App allows your smartphone to serve as a key and enable engine start and cabin preconditioning remotely. The sound system includes 12 speakers with 600 watts, delivering crisp, immersive audio. Hands-free voice-operated phone calls and HD radio keep you connected and entertained effortlessly, while the touch screen display streamlines all interactions.

2025 Rivian R1S Performance Features

Performance is at the core of this used Rivian R1S, featuring DC fast charging capability to minimize downtime. Its electric lithium iron phosphate battery powers a sophisticated all-wheel drive system with on-demand 4WD, ensuring traction in all conditions. The air suspension and driver-adjustable height suspension provide a smooth ride, whether on rough terrain or smooth pavement. Pneumatic rear and front springs, combined with self-leveling suspension, optimize ride quality and load handling, making this SUV ready for any adventure.

The 2025 GMC Yukon Elevation is a full-size SUV designed for drivers who value space, modern features, and a proven ownership history.

This SUV is a strong fit for those who need substantial passenger capacity, flexible cargo options, and the comfort of upscale appointments. The inclusion of heated front and rear seats, three-zone automatic climate control, and a navigation system means that both drivers and passengers can expect a refined, connected ride. In areas like rd St. Homewood, IL, where weather can be unpredictable, the 4WD system and heated steering wheel add practicality for year-round driving, while the Power Liftgate and split-bench third row make loading and unloading easy whether it's groceries or sports gear.

Performance is anchored by a 3.0L I6 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission, providing smooth acceleration and confident highway merging. The powertrain is tuned for both strength and efficiency, while the Premium Smooth Ride Suspension and four-wheel independent setup help absorb road imperfections, delivering a composed and comfortable experience for occupants even on longer drives. The 4WD drivetrain ensures the Yukon Elevation remains surefooted across diverse road conditions, making it suitable for everything from urban commuting to family road trips.

Safety is a highlight, with features designed to protect and assist in real-world scenarios. Anti-lock brakes (ABS) and electronic stability control work together to maintain control during emergency maneuvers or slippery situations. The SUV is equipped with dual front and side impact airbags, an overhead airbag, and occupant sensing technology for comprehensive protection. Rear parking camera support simplifies reversing, while rain-sensing wipers and auto high-beam headlights enhance driver visibility in changing weather conditions. Super Cruise, GMC's advanced hands-free driving technology, further elevates safety and convenience during highway travel.

The Elevation Premium Package brings a host of desirable amenities, including CoreTech/Perforated Leather-Appointed Seating, Bose 10-Speaker Surround with CenterPoint, and a large 16.8-inch GMC Infotainment System featuring Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. Navigation is seamlessly integrated, and the power-release second-row bucket seats maximize ease of access to the third row. Additional highlights include heated mirrors, memory seating, and the OnStar emergency communication system, ensuring both comfort and peace of mind are standard.

Against competitors like the Chevrolet Tahoe and Ford Expedition, the Yukon Elevation stands out with its blend of upscale interior touches, advanced infotainment options, and innovative driver assistance features such as Super Cruise. While all three SUVs offer strong towing and passenger capabilities, the Yukon’s premium package enhancements and clean vehicle history give it a notable edge for those prioritizing technology and peace of mind in a family vehicle.

What are the key features of this SUV? The Yukon Elevation includes heated leather seating, a power liftgate, navigation, Super Cruise, and a premium Bose audio system. How does it perform in daily driving? The 3.0L I6 engine and 10-speed automatic transmission deliver responsive yet smooth power, while 4WD ensures readiness for varied road conditions.

To learn more or schedule a test drive of this 2025 GMC Yukon Elevation, contact Ford of Homewood at 708-356-9308 or visit 3233 183rd St. Homewood, IL 60430. Discover how this well-equipped, one-owner SUV can meet your needs with confidence and value.

*COURTESY VEHICLE*

Vehicle Details
The 2027 INFINITI QX60 SPORT is an INFINITI of Boerne courtesy vehicle with fewer than 10,000 miles that has never been titled or registered to a retail owner. Its 268-horsepower 2.0-liter VC-Turbo engine, nine-speed automatic transmission and standard Intelligent All-Wheel Drive are joined by SPORT-specific 20-inch gloss-black wheels, dark exterior accents, second-row captain's chairs and a distinctive SPORT front fascia, creating a six-passenger luxury SUV offered at a significant discount from its original MSRP.

This QX60 SPORT is sold as INFINITI Certified with 6-year/75,000-mile limited warranty coverage from the original in-service date, plus applicable INFINITI Certified benefits. It also includes the complimentary Synergy Commitment from INFINITI of Boerne, providing additional powertrain protection through a total of 7 years/100,000 total odometer miles from the original in-service date. The two forms of coverage are distinct: the INFINITI Certified limited warranty provides its specified coverage, while the Synergy Commitment adds dealership-provided powertrain protection for longer-term ownership support.

The value proposition begins with how this QX60 has been used. Rather than having a previous retail owner, it served INFINITI of Boerne as a dealer courtesy vehicle for purposes such as service-loaner or executive transportation and has been maintained and regularly inspected by the dealership's factory-trained technicians. That dealership service creates mileage without creating a previous retail ownership history, allowing the next owner to experience a low-mileage, nearly new INFINITI while benefiting from pricing significantly below the vehicle's original MSRP.

The SPORT trim gives the QX60 a noticeably different personality without sacrificing the qualities that make it practical as a three-row luxury crossover. Its unique 20-inch gloss-black wheels work with dark treatments across the grille, emblems, window surrounds and body-side moldings, while the SPORT-specific lower front fascia gives the nose a more assertive appearance. Inside, the SPORT changes the second row from a bench to individual captain's chairs with a removable center console, creating a six-passenger configuration that gives second-row occupants more personal space and makes movement toward the third row easier. The result should appeal particularly well to families who regularly carry four or five people but still want the flexibility of a third row.

Its engineering is equally interesting. The 2.0-liter VC-Turbo four-cylinder produces 268 horsepower and 286 lb-ft of torque, but the more important story is how it delivers that output. Variable-compression technology can alter the engine's compression characteristics as driving demands change, prioritizing stronger response when the driver asks for power and greater efficiency under lighter loads. The nine-speed automatic gives the engine a broad range of ratios to work with, while standard Intelligent All-Wheel Drive can help distribute power according to available traction. That combination suits everything from an I-10 commute to winding Hill Country roads without turning the QX60 SPORT into an unnecessarily harsh performance SUV.

Luxury here is designed around daily usability. Climate-controlled front seats help manage Texas temperature swings, while the second-row captain's chairs create a more individual passenger experience. The QX60 SPORT also incorporates a 12.3-inch multi-function driver display and a Klipsch premium audio system, putting important driving information directly in the driver's sightline while providing a richer listening environment throughout the cabin. Smartphone integration and connected technology make the vehicle equally comfortable handling an airport run, a business day or a weekend trip.

The QX60's three-row layout also gives it a practical advantage for owners whose passenger and cargo needs change from one day to the next. The third row can accommodate additional passengers when needed, then fold when cargo space becomes the priority. That adaptability is important in a luxury family SUV because usefulness should not require giving up refinement. With up to 6,000 pounds of available towing capacity when properly equipped, the QX60 platform also has the capability to support larger recreational demands.

Driver-assistance technology works in much the same way: the objective is to reduce workload rather than distract the driver. ProPILOT Assist combines technologies including Intelligent Cruise Control and steering assistance to help make sustained highway travel less demanding, while Blind Spot Intervention can provide an additional layer of assistance when surrounding traffic becomes difficult to track. The 3D Around View Monitor provides multiple perspectives around the QX60, making its size easier to manage in parking garages, crowded lots and tighter spaces.

Because this QX60 SPORT has never been titled or registered to a retail owner, it may qualify for special leasing programs for qualified customers. Purchasing remains equally compelling for a buyer focused on the combination of low mileage, Certified coverage, additional Synergy Commitment powertrain protection and savings from the original MSRP.

INFINITI of Boerne is locally owned and operated and is a 2026 J.D. Power Dealer of Excellence, the first INFINITI retailer in Texas to earn it, as well as a Five-time INFINITI Award of Excellence recipient. Located directly on Interstate 10 north of San Antonio, the dealership also offers complimentary Texas home delivery, making this QX60 SPORT accessible to luxury buyers throughout Greater San Antonio and Austin who see value in purchasing beyond their immediate area.

Experience this 2027 INFINITI QX60 SPORT at INFINITI of Boerne and discover what makes a low-mileage courtesy vehicle such a compelling way to own a nearly new INFINITI.

Experience the 2023 Dodge Durango R/T Premium, a versatile SUV that combines power, luxury, and advanced tech in a stylish package. With only 14,220 miles, this used vehicle offers a commanding presence in its sleek DB Black Clear Coat exterior, complemented by a refined Black/Ebony Red interior. Powered by a robust 5.7-liter V8 engine delivering 360 horsepower and 390 lb-ft of torque, it provides impressive performance paired with an 8-speed shiftable automatic transmission and all-wheel drive for confident handling. This Durango is loaded with features designed to elevate your driving experience, including adaptive cruise control, Apple CarPlay, backup camera, blind spot monitor, Bluetooth, collision warning, cross traffic alert, heated seats, keyless entry, memory seats, navigation, premium audio, push start, rear A/C, rear heated seats, satellite radio readiness, sunroof/moonroof, third-row seating, tow package, WiFi hotspot, and wireless phone charging. The Durango is equipped with automatic emergency braking at the rear to help prevent collisions, along with a rear check seat reminder to ensure no occupant is overlooked. Driver knee airbags add an extra layer of protection, while front and rear parking sensors assist with maneuvering in tight spaces. Four-wheel ABS provides stability during braking, complemented by emergency braking preparation for quick response. Power door locks offer anti-lockout and auto-locking functions, enhancing security, and brake drying improves stopping performance in wet conditions.

2023 Dodge Durango Entertainment and Technology Features

Inside, the Durango offers a premium entertainment system with 18 speakers generating 825 watts for immersive sound. The 10.1-inch infotainment touchscreen is compatible with SiriusXM Guardian smart device apps, allowing remote start and cabin preconditioning. Voice-operated systems facilitate hands-free phone calls and radio controls, while HD radio, surround sound (7.1), and a touch screen display complete the high-end audio experience, keeping occupants connected and entertained on every journey.

2023 Dodge Durango Performance Features

Performance is a key highlight of this Durango with a self-leveling suspension that smooths out rough roads and enhances ride comfort. Cylinder deactivation helps improve fuel efficiency without sacrificing power, while the sport-tuned suspension delivers sharper handling. The SUV features an on-demand 4WD system, providing traction when needed and switching seamlessly between two-wheel and four-wheel drive modes to adapt to changing road conditions.

This 2023 Ford Bronco Badlands Advanced is fitted with a ReadyLIFT 3" lift kit, KMC 17" wheels finished in satin black, and 37x13.50R17 Nitto Ridge Grappler tires, giving the body additional clearance and filling the wheel openings with a more aggressive off-road tire package. The suspension and wheel combination is paired with fabricated upper control arms and a four-wheel alignment as part of the lift installation, which keeps the changes tied to a complete hardware update rather than a simple height increase. The Badlands trim's trail-focused character is supported by a Ford Performance Heavy-Duty Modular Front Bumper, brush guard, and body armor protective moldings, along with a removable hoop step for easier entry. A front license plate bracket is also included, and the black roof rails with crossbars add practical exterior carrying points.

Inside, this Bronco includes Equipment Group 334A, which brings a Premium Audio system, Apple CarPlay, navigation, a Wi-Fi hotspot, and adaptive cruise control. Collision warning is included as well, giving the driver an added layer of monitoring on the road. The cabin also has a hard top sound deadening headliner, which is aimed at reducing noise transfer from the roof area, and a keyless entry keypad for access without relying solely on the key fob. These items make the truck more convenient to use day to day while keeping the interior equipment focused on function rather than ornament.

On the trail side, this Bronco is equipped with Trail Control, Trail Turn Assist, and Trail One-Pedal Driving, along with towing capability for additional utility when the route is not limited to pavement. The Advanced 4x4 system is part of the model's capability set, and the Badlands trim is the version of the Bronco line built with off-road hardware in mind. The added ride height from the lift and the larger tire size work alongside that factory hardware to increase ground clearance and change the vehicle's stance without altering the Bronco's basic purpose. The combination of trail-oriented controls and the upgraded exterior protection gives the truck a straightforward specification for mixed use.

The exterior also includes a full twill soft retractable top, which gives the vehicle an open-air option while still retaining a quick way to close it up when needed. That top works alongside the hard top sound deadening headliner mentioned earlier, so the vehicle carries both comfort-related and weather-related equipment. The overall build keeps the details practical, with the black roof rails, front bumper, brush guard, and molded body protection adding pieces that are visible and functional without changing the Bronco's factory identity.
